							env,
							{p3:String} AS temporality,
							metric_name,

							bucket_unix_milli AS unix_milli,
							sum(series_increment) AS sum,
							count() AS count_series,
							sum(num_values) AS count_samples,
							now() AS computed_at
						FROM
						(
							SELECT
								env,
								temporality,
								metric_name,
								reduced_fingerprint,
								fingerprint,
								bucket_unix_milli,
								sum(increment) AS series_increment,
								count() AS num_values
							FROM
							(
								SELECT
									env,
									temporality,
									metric_name,
									reduced_fingerprint,
									fingerprint,
									intDiv(unix_milli, {p4:Int64}) * {p5:Int64} AS bucket_unix_milli,
									multiIf(
										row_number() OVER rate_window = {p6:Int64}, nan,
										value < lagInFrame(value, {p7:Int64}) OVER rate_window, value,
										value - lagInFrame(value, {p8:Int64}) OVER rate_window

								FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4_buffer

								WHERE (bitAnd(flags, {p10:Int64}) = {p11:Int64})
									AND ((temporality = {p12:String}) AND (is_monotonic = {p13:Bool}))

								WINDOW rate_window AS (PARTITION BY env, temporality, metric_name, fingerprint ORDER BY unix_milli)
							)
							WHERE (isNaN(increment) = {p18:Int64})
								AND (bucket_unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute({p19:Int64})) * {p20:Int64}))
							GROUP BY
								env,
								temporality,
								metric_name,

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS signoz_metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_60s_mv ON CLUSTER cluster REFRESH EVERY {p1:Int64} MINUTE RANDOMIZE FOR {p2:Int64} SECOND APPEND TO signoz_metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_60s (env LowCardinality(String), temporality LowCardinality(String), metric_name LowCardinality(String), reduced_fingerprint UInt64, unix_milli Int64, sum_last Float64, min Float64, max Float64, sum_values Float64, count_series UInt64, count_samples UInt64, computed_at DateTime) EMPTY AS SELECT
							env,
							temporality,
							metric_name,
							reduced_fingerprint,
							bucket_unix_milli AS unix_milli,
							sum(last) AS sum_last,
							min(min_value) AS min,
							max(max_value) AS max,
							sum(sum_value) AS sum_values,
							count() AS count_series,
							sum(num_values) AS count_samples,
							now() AS computed_at
						FROM
						(
							SELECT
								env,
								temporality,
								metric_name,
								reduced_fingerprint,
								fingerprint,
								intDiv(unix_milli, {p3:Int64}) * {p4:Int64} AS bucket_unix_milli,
								argMax(value, unix_milli) AS last,
								min(value) AS min_value,
								max(value) AS max_value,
								sum(value) AS sum_value,
								count(value) AS num_values
							FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4_buffer
							PREWHERE reduced_fingerprint != {p5:Int64}
							WHERE (bitAnd(flags, {p6:Int64}) = {p7:Int64})
								AND ((temporality = {p8:String}) OR ((temporality = {p9:String}) AND (is_monotonic = {p10:Bool})))
								AND (unix_milli < (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalSecond({p11:Int64})) * {p12:Int64}))
								AND (unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute({p13:Int64})) * {p14:Int64}))
							GROUP BY
								env,
								temporality,
								metric_name,
								reduced_fingerprint,
								fingerprint,
								bucket_unix_milli
						)
						WHERE bucket_unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute({p15:Int64})) * {p16:Int64})
						GROUP BY
							env,
							temporality,
							metric_name,
							reduced_fingerprint,
							bucket_unix_milli
